shouldFix.title: The actor-join limb is left unclassified, though it is named in the D-056 reason the artifact quotes and in the D-093 unmet list the artifact undertakes to measure
shouldFix.finding: D-056's ineligible reason for DR-105, which the artifact reproduces byte-exact, has three parts and ends 'Actor-join / host-effect still design.' D-093's recorded remaining-unmet list has six members: FC-C1, DR-G09 fixture execution, BLK-1..BLK-4, D-042 advisory honesty work, and DR-114 actor-join and fixture-corpus execution. The artifact's purpose says it measures 'the D-042 / D-093 remaining-unmet list'. Five of the six are classified — FC-C1, G09 as two obligations, the four BLKs, and the advisory honesty work under its own group. The actor-join member is classified nowhere. DR-114 occurs once in the whole file, inside OBL-BLK-4's non-retargeting refusal, and actor-join occurs once, inside the quoted D-056 reason. The gap is visible inside the artifact's own staleness block: the field keyed actorJoinHostEffectStillDesign answers only the host-effect limb, citing D-093, D-126 and D-128, and never reaches the actor-join limb its own key names.
shouldFix.whyItMatters: The artifact is the inventory a later act will read to know what DR-105 still owes and where each piece sits. It classifies every other member of both recorded lists, including two that are not leftover at all, so carrying five of six reads as completeness the file does not have. The item is also live rather than spent: D-129 recorded a DR-114 leftover-integration candidate that binds NOTHING and SATISFIES no row, so actor-join remains genuinely unmet.
shouldFix.whyNotBlocker: Nothing false is asserted, and DR-105's eligibility conclusion is unaffected either way — six leftover obligations already prevent gates 2 and 3 from holding, so no classification of the actor-join limb could make this row eligible. The omission understates the inventory, not the standing.
shouldFix.repair: Classify the actor-join limb explicitly and extend the staleness field to cover it. Which classification is right is the drafter's call, not mine: either an obligation riding DR-114 in the shape of the other cross-row entries, noting D-129's recorded candidate binds nothing, or a statement that the limb is DR-114's leftover and off this row. Either resolves it; silence does not.

coordinatorSummary: REJECT at 0 blockers and 1 SHOULD-FIX. Fourteen attacks run, one landed, and the repair is additive. Custody holds: subject c5486464 at 0444 unmoved with dispatch and prompt agreeing, HEAD never left 8fd376d, file 08 at 3a9442d1 equal to the subject's own pin, governing tree clean, and all seven cited files reproduce including permission-truth-tables.v9 at the digest v5 cites. The hard parts are right. The token inversion from DR-104 is handled correctly — DR-105's live cell opens with OPEN, so leftover-design/OPEN is the token here rather than a finding, and the artifact says exactly that. D-032's BLK dispositions are reproduced accurately: BLK-1 through 4 still-routed and leftover, BLK-5 discharged, BLK-6 discharged-as-inapplicable for host default reads and doctor's operational-metadata write, BLK-7 repaired in v4, none of the last three treated as leftover. The G09 split is the shape Codex had to force onto the DR-101 join, applied here unprompted: the unauthored harness specification is leftover on D-056 Decision clause 5 while execution stays qualification at the named gate, with an express statement that the join does not claim the unauthored harness exists. The G09 owner is byte-exact and kept distinct from the row owner, the D-056 ineligible reason is quoted byte-exact, and the fourteen obligations partition cleanly across five groups. D-042's named unmet list is fully carried. The objection is D-093's. Its recorded remaining-unmet list has six members and the artifact classifies five: FC-C1, G09, the four BLKs and the advisory honesty work are all placed, but DR-114 actor-join and fixture-corpus execution is placed nowhere. DR-114 appears once in the file, inside a non-retargeting refusal, and actor-join appears once, inside the quoted D-056 reason — a reason whose own text ends 'Actor-join / host-effect still design' and whose staleness field, keyed actorJoinHostEffectStillDesign, answers only the host-effect limb. The item is live, not spent: D-129 recorded a DR-114 candidate that binds nothing and satisfies no row. I graded it SHOULD-FIX rather than a blocker because six leftover obligations already hold gates 2 and 3 shut, so no classification of this limb changes DR-105's standing — the inventory is understated, not the eligibility. I deliberately do not decide whether the limb is DR-105's leftover or DR-114's; the artifact's own materials point both ways, and my finding is that it must answer the question.
